notes: Norway and Svalbard are kept as separate rows and never merged.

60 rows are held unresolved by the source-row coherence check (46 NorTaxa species-aggregate 'coll.' vs strict-species workbook, 14 spelling variants or nom. dub. flags); 22 conflict groups with disagreeing categories are recorded verbatim in redlist_no_diagnostics.json.collisions.conflicts for later curation.

Runtime API: get_redlist_lookup(...) returns an explicit RedlistLookupResult (status: none / unique / multiple_same_category / conflict). The legacy get_redlist_assessment(...) returns None for conflict groups — never auto-picks.
The bridge namespace is artsnavnebase_scientific_name_id (Artsdatabanken's name registry), NOT artsdatabanken_taxon_concept_id.
